reasons.population_gates: User 2026-11-12 (grill Q2): T, NK and gamma-delta T. CD3pos then CD4/CD8 quad gate (as 3D); TCRgd under CD3pos; CD3neg then CD56+ NK. The panel has no CD19 or CD14. Search window c(0, 3) is my proposal, shown in the density figures for approval. NKpos window c(0.3, 2.5): user 2026-11-12 (first fit cut at 2.89, above the shoulder). TCRgdpos: gate sits under CD3pos; method pending, user wants plots of mindensity2 vs a tail cut (99b_gate_candidates.R). label: plain name of each population, used in figure titles. User 2026-11-13: TCRgd cut = cytoUtils gate_tail on CD3+ cells (0.41, 99b candidate_cuts.csv); CD1c DC cut = negative peak + 4 SD on pooled AS 1.8.8 CD11c+ events (1.2759, 99b candidate_cuts.csv), fixed here so the gate does not move; the CD1c readout cut stays fixed 1.0 (a separate choice).
